# Florida Pool Resurfacing Match

> Florida Pool Resurfacing Match is a free referral service that connects Florida homeowners with up to 3 independent local pool resurfacing and repair companies. It is not a contractor and does not perform pool resurfacing and repair work. Content cites Florida statutes, utility water-quality reports and city/county permit offices, and labels national estimates as such.

Last updated: 2026-11-21

## Key facts (sourced on the linked pages)
- Florida's pool/spa servicing contractor scope includes interior refinishing, repair or replacement of existing equipment and substantial draining of a pool for repair or renovation, s. 489.105(3) F.S.
- Atlantic Beach lists pools more than 24 inches deep among residential work requiring a building permit; Neptune Beach lists swimming pools.
- Angi 2026 national average for pool resurfacing: $11,000 (range $6,000-$15,000).

## Guides
- [Who can resurface a pool in Florida? License rules explained](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/guides/florida-pool-contractor-license-rules/): What Florida's pool/spa contractor definitions cover, what they exclude, and how to check a license.
- [Your pool's fill water in Northeast Florida: hardness by utility](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/guides/northeast-florida-pool-fill-water/): Published hardness and treatment for JEA ZIP codes and local city systems, useful when you refill after resurfacing.

## Service areas
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in St. Augustine, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/st-augustine/): Fill water here comes from City of St. Augustine Utilities; Florida treats resurfacing as licensed pool/spa contractor work.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in World Golf Village, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/world-golf-village/): Fill water here comes from JEA or St. Johns County Utility, depending on address; Florida treats resurfacing as licensed pool/spa contractor work.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Atlantic Beach & Neptune Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/atlantic-beach-neptune-beach/): Fill water here comes from City of Atlantic Beach / City of Neptune Beach; Florida treats resurfacing as licensed pool/spa contractor work.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Fleming Island, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/fleming-island/): Fill water here comes from Clay County Utility Authority (CCUA); Florida treats resurfacing as licensed pool/spa contractor work.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Orange Park, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/orange-park/): Fill water here comes from Town of Orange Park (in town); JEA or CCUA nearby; Florida treats resurfacing as licensed pool/spa contractor work.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Fernandina Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/fernandina-beach/): Fill water here comes from City of Fernandina Beach; Florida treats resurfacing as licensed pool/spa contractor work.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Tampa, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/tampa/): Fill water: City of Tampa reported 12.3 grains per gallon (211 mg/L) for 2025.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in St. Petersburg, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/st-petersburg/): Fill water: Tampa Bay Water blend at 158 mg/L hardness and pH 8.2 (2025 averages).
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Clearwater, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/clearwater/): Fill water is city RO-treated well water; pool installation is on Clearwater's permit list.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Largo, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/largo/): Largo pool/spa permits need a Duke Energy No Conflict letter and a Pool/Spa Safety Act affidavit.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Dunedin, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/dunedin/): Fill water is Dunedin's RO-treated well water; pool permits use a fence/enclosure affidavit.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Tarpon Springs, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/tarpon-springs/): Fill water: Tarpon Springs RO water, about 45 mg/L calcium hardness target.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Winter Park, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/winter-park/): Fill water: Winter Park's ozone-treated lower Floridan wells; pools count toward the 50% impervious cap.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Oviedo, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/oviedo/): Fill water: Oviedo's 10 Floridan wells, aerated and chloramine-disinfected.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Sanford, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/sanford/): Fill water: Sanford's 17-well Floridan system with polyphosphate corrosion control.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Kissimmee, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/kissimmee/): Fill water: Toho Water Authority's aerated Floridan Aquifer supply.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Winter Garden, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/winter-garden/): Fill water: Winter Garden's six-well Floridan supply; pools need a Zoning Compliance Review.
- [Pool Resurfacing & Repair in Lake Mary, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-pool-resurfacing-match/pool-resurfacing/lake-mary/): Fill water: Lake Mary's UV advanced oxidation and carbon-treated well water.
